description: Play seven familiar melodies with your hands. See yourself on stage and hear every note you play.

sections.title: Play with your hands
sections.text: Choose Start camera or press K2. Show both hands. Play with your left hand and make a fist with your right. Raise 1–5 fingers for Do–Sol, extend your thumb and pinky for La, or make an OK sign for Si. Close and reopen your hand to repeat a note. Point your other thumb up or down to change octave.

sections.title: Choose your pace
sections.text: Follow waits for your next note. For a timed round, open Songbook and choose Challenge. Play by touch lets you use the seven note pads without a camera.

controls.action: Start or stop the camera and sound

sections.title: Import a score
sections.text: In Songbook, choose Import JSON score. Example: {"title":"Three notes","bpm":60,"notes":[[3,1],[2,1],[1,2]]}. Use [scale degree, beats, optional octave]. A 0 is a rest. Octaves are -1, 0 or 1.
